school.name: Benjamin Franklin High School for Finance & Information Technology
school.overview: BFIT is committed to providing students with the skills to become college and career ready. Through a rich curriculum and exposure to the diversity of NYC and its opportunities, students will benefit from real world opportunities to communicate, collaborate, and solve problems. Students are held to high expectations to demonstrate the level of professionalism and academic responsibility required to be 21st leaders.

programs.name: Benjamin Franklin High School for Finance & Information Technology (Q73A)
programs.description: Accounting, Business, Finance, Web Design, Graphic Design, Programming, and Information Technology.
